description:
The City Council Finance Committee will meet to hear department presentations regarding the proposed 2026 budgets.

• Department of Neighborhood Engagement
• Mayor’s Office, Solicitor’s Office and Elected Officials
• Department of Public Works
• Enterprise Funds (Utilities)

In accordance with the provisions of the City's Home Rule Charter, members of the public are invited to ask questions about the proposed 2026 budget through Engage Lancaster. Answers will posted on Engage Lancaster at least seven (7) days prior to the scheduled budget adoption.

https://engage.cityoflancasterpa.gov/en/projects/2026-budget-questions

Please note, live chat will not be monitored by staff during this meeting, and is not considered public comment for this meeting. For more information about City Council's public comment policy, visit http://www.cityoflancasterpa.gov/city-council.
